label: Cutzamala Reservoir Level
contestNote: Reached 90.7% in January 2026 (best in 6 years) after strong 2025 rainy season. Declined to 76.7% by April 7 amid pre-rainy season drawdown. Still well above May 2024 historic low of 30%. A 604M peso modernization (new valves, SCADA control system) is underway after 40 years without major upgrades.
deltaNote: Seasonal decline expected through May; recovery anticipated from June rainy season

label: CDMX Annual Budget 2025
source: Congreso CDMX / Secretaría de Finanzas CDMX Dec 2024
deltaNote: Includes MXN 23B for Metro modernization — largest Metro investment in history

label: Max Land Subsidence Rate
contestNote: Historic center sinking ~50cm/yr in worst zones; Palacio de Bellas Artes and Cathedral visibly tilting. Caused by groundwater over-extraction from ancient lake bed. NASA NISAR satellite data (published May 2026, Oct 2025–Jan 2026 measurements) confirmed 14 in/yr (~35 cm) at monitored landmarks including AICM airport and the Ángel de la Independencia monument.
